english: Let $z$ and $w$ be complex numbers satisfying $z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1+i$ and $2\bar{z}+(1-i)w=1$, where $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Then the value of $\mathrm{Im}(zw)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $z$ तथा $w$ ऐसी सम्मिश्र संख्याएँ हैं जो $z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1+i$ तथा $2\bar{z}+(1-i)w=1$ को संतुष्ट करती हैं, जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। तब $\mathrm{Im}(zw)$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Conjugate the second equation: $2z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1$; together with $z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1+i$ this is linear in $z$ and $\bar{w}$
solution_full: The unknowns appear as $z,\bar{w}$ in the first equation and as $\bar{z},w$ in the second. Taking the conjugate of the second equation (the conjugate of a sum and product is the sum and product of conjugates): $2z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1$.
Now both equations are linear in $z$ and $\bar{w}$: $z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1+i$ and $2z+(1+i)\bar{w}=1$.
Subtracting the first from the second: $z=1-(1+i)=-i$.
Check in the original second equation: $2\bar{z}+(1-i)w=2i+\dfrac{(1-i)(3-i)}{2}=2i+\dfrac{2-4i}{2}=2i+1-2i=1$.
originality_note: New: a pair of equations in which z and w appear conjugated in opposite places; conjugating one equation makes the system linear in z and wbar (way 4). Closest known: linear systems in z and w with complex coefficients; z + a zbar = b. Different because: the mixed conjugates prevent direct elimination until one equation is conjugated; a light question.
blueprint_concepts: Equations and systems involving z and z_bar

concept_use.Equations and systems involving z and z_: Conjugating 2 zbar + (1-i) w = 1 gives 2z + (1+i) wbar = 1, so the system becomes linear in z and wbar and is solved by elimination.

key_step: Conjugate the second equation so both are linear in z and wbar, then eliminate.
justification: A routine chain (conjugate, eliminate, divide, multiply) with one idea; level 2, lighter than 2023-P1-Q17 (L3).
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, locus and parameter is introduced, the conditions are complete, there is one reading, the answer is unique and equals the Answer Plan, and the Hindi mirrors the English. Checked that the system has a unique solution and verified it in both original equations. Answer -1.5, negative decimal. No change.
